title: Piercing Statue Duo #030 (데미스탯 · [데미스탯·P25 집중형·wenge·메이크업 스페인플라멩코글램] ; [데미스탯·P25 집중형·내용물·코발트 블루 유리+수정 조각·메이크업 BollywoodGlam])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi statue portrait. TWO women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Spanish woman — dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge yellow-gold stud hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide yellow-gold ear cuff, three smaller yellow-gold rings, two thick yellow-gold bars and a small yellow-gold stud up to the top; one small yellow-gold stud sits in the right ear; four thin yellow-gold bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small yellow-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick yellow-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a yellow-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a yellow-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small yellow-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a yellow-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a yellow-gold labret stud and a small yellow-gold ring sit on the chin; three small yellow-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid dark wenge wood, a deep near-black wood finely striped with narrow gold-tan pinstripes running through it, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Indian woman — kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in elegant updo. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge mixed-metal bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, three smaller mixed-metal rings, two thick mixed-metal bars and a small mixed-metal stud up to the top; one small mixed-metal stud sits in the right ear; four thin mixed-metal bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small mixed-metal rings pass through the left nostril and a thick mixed-metal septum ring hangs below the nose; a mixed-metal hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a mixed-metal snake-bite ring beside it and a small mixed-metal ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a mixed-metal Medusa stud sits above the lips; a mixed-metal labret stud and a small mixed-metal ring sit on the chin; three small mixed-metal studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal.
#2 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is ONE solid, continuous block of deep cobalt-blue cast glass, with slow internal swirls and tiny bubbles, near-navy where thickest and bright cobalt at every thin edge, carved as one uniform sculpted mass, never hollow, never split down the centre. Yet suspended deep within this solid material, visible through it exactly like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are dozens of small, jagged clear quartz shards like frozen lightning bolts, each one a brighter, sharper facet than the glass around it, spread naturally from her chest down through her belly, hips and both thighs, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity, no hollow chamber and no liquid around it — the material itself grew solid around them. The material reads as one unbroken solid mass throughout; the embedded shapes are simply what is visible deep inside it, not a separate vessel. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep royal blue on one side and a cool silver on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
